checks: Batch captures all six fields and dose counts with per-row overrides
Invalid count, empty selected patient, missing identity and invalid date reject the complete batch
Duplicate detection is account plus date, with separate episodes and soft-deleted records excluded
Search treats 2-1 and 02-01 as the same bed without mixing rooms
Edit retains original values in history and keeps the record identity
Storage writes are serialized; failed write does not claim committed state
Backup merge is idempotent, preserves local changes and restores unsaved drafts
Print paginates 24 rows, includes blank stamp cells, and escapes patient text
Portal extracts all six fields, clears stale bed filters, and only clicks one ward query
Portal bridge rejects settlement, patient-opening and unknown actions
Portal query waits for refreshed data and reads cleared patients
Portal rejects ambiguous identities and wrong-origin pages
Ward defaults migrate from old preferences and survive backup restore
Records are stored under separate ward keys and old flat backups migrate without loss
Print/export refuse mixed wards, and record dates and bed numbers sort naturally
